verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's API supports personal access tokens (pt_secret_ format) and an OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, so an agent can be given its own dedicated credential. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be narrowed to specific resources or actions, so least-privilege issuance is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or token permission levels, read-only or resource-limited token options, per-token revocation and management controls, and independent corroboration.
